title: Correct final force F1
description: Essential: The answer must give F1 = (μ₀ N I A ℰ) / (2 ℓ R r) or an equivalent simplified form.

title: Correct final force F2
description: Essential: The answer must state F2 = -F1, indicating equal magnitude and opposite direction.

title: Identifies loop current
description: Important: The solution correctly uses the loop current J = ℰ/R from Ohm's law.

title: Applies magnetic interaction model
description: Important: The solution uses a valid physical model (e.g., force on magnetic dipole, mutual inductance energy, or Lorentz force on equivalent poles) to relate the solenoid and loop fields.

title: Uses solenoid field approximation
description: Important: The solution correctly applies the approximation for the magnetic field of a long solenoid (B = μ₀ N I / ℓ) or its equivalent flux.

title: Considers loop field at center
description: Important: The solution correctly uses the magnetic field at the center of a current loop, B_loop = μ₀ J / (2r).

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the direction of F1 or the sign of F2 is incorrect (e.g., missing negative sign for F2).

title: Unit or constant omission
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the answer omits fundamental constants (μ₀) or key parameters (N, A, ℓ, r, R, I, ℰ).

title: Exploits symmetry or Newton's third law
description: Optional: The solution explicitly notes the symmetry or uses Newton's third law to justify F2 = -F1.
